name: @hummingbirdui/mcp

tools.name: list-blocks
tools.description:
List all available pre-built Hummingbird UI blocks, optionally filtered by category.

Returns block names, URIs, and descriptions so you can decide which blocks to load in generate-ui.

Available categories: authentication-forms, cta-sections, feature-sections, footers, hero-sections, layouts, pricing-plans, stats, team-sections, testimonials

category.description: Optional category to filter by. One of: authentication-forms, cta-sections, feature-sections, footers, hero-sections, layouts, pricing-plans, stats, team-sections, testimonials

tools.name: list-components
tools.description:
List all available Hummingbird UI components and their doc slugs, optionally filtered by group.

Use the returned slugs in the `components` param of `generate-ui` to load the right docs as context.

Available groups: components, forms, advanced-forms, layout, content, customize

group.description: Optional group to filter by. One of: components, forms, advanced-forms, layout, content, customize

tools.name: generate-ui
tools.description:
Generate a UI component or full page section using Hummingbird (Tailwind CSS v4).

## Block-first approach
Pre-built blocks are ALWAYS preferred over generating from scratch. Before generating custom HTML, this tool checks for matching blocks and uses them as the base — adapting content and layout only as needed.

Available block categories: authentication-forms, cta-sections, feature-sections, footers, hero-sections, layouts, pricing-plans, stats, team-sections, testimonials

Describe what you want in plain English and get back clean, semantic HTML using Hummingbird components and pre-built blocks.

Optionally pass component slugs to load their docs as context. Available slugs:
  components       → accordion, alerts, avatars, badges, breadcrumb, button-group, buttons, card, carousel, close-button, collapses, custom-scrollbar, divider, dropdowns, link, list-group, loaders, modal, navbar, navs-tabs, offcanvas, pagination, placeholders, popovers, progress, scrollspy, tables, toasts, tooltips
  forms            → checkbox, file-input, floating-labels, form-control, input-group, radio, range, select, switch, validation
  advanced-forms   → advanced-range, advanced-select, date-time-picker, file-uploader
  layout           → columns, container, grid
  content          → background, images, shadows, typography, video
  customize        → colors, component, dark-mode, reboot, theming

prompt.description: Plain-English description of the UI to generate. E.g. 'A pricing table with three tiers, a highlighted Pro plan, feature checkmarks, and a CTA button per column'.

components.description: Optional slugs of Hummingbird components to load as context (e.g. ['card', 'buttons', 'badges']). If omitted, a sensible default set is used.

blockCategories.description: Optional block categories to load as context. The tool auto-detects relevant categories from your prompt, but you can override here. Available: authentication-forms, cta-sections, feature-sections, footers, hero-sections, layouts, pricing-plans, stats, team-sections, testimonials

noBlocks.description: Set to true to skip block context entirely and generate from scratch. Use only when you need a fully custom design not covered by any block.
